description: Historical map/source registry for the exact circuit configurations required by the 1980 Formula One season. These sources establish configuration identity and provide legally explicit inputs for future schematic/vector geometry extraction.

sources.title: Autódromo Oscar y Juan Gálvez Circuito N° 15 Senna.svg
sources.author: Gustavo Girardelli
sources.notes: Commons file is explicitly the Circuit No. 15 configuration and is used on 1979-1981 Argentine GP pages. Geometry derivation must preserve attribution/share-alike obligations.

sources.title: Circuit Interlagos 1977.svg
sources.author: Ahnode
sources.notes: Public-domain diagram of the original long circuit. Suitable as a low-friction source for schematic vector extraction after visual review against 1980 references.

sources.title: Kyalami 1961 - 1988 Layout.png
sources.author: Kroema
sources.notes: Explicitly describes the original Kyalami Grand Prix circuit used during the 1980 period.

sources.title: Long Beach 1978.jpg
sources.author: Jiří Žemlička
sources.notes: Public-domain map explicitly labelled for the 1978-1981 route. This is the correct 1980 Long Beach layout family.

sources.title: Circuit Zolder-1975-1985.svg
sources.author: Pitlane02
sources.notes: Exact period family covering the 1980 Belgian Grand Prix.

sources.title: Circuit de Monaco 1976.png
sources.author: Mario30095
sources.notes: Commons description states this is the 1976-1985 configuration. Source page also carries a PD-self permission note; CC BY-SA 3.0 is retained here as the conservative reuse license.

sources.title: Circuit Paul Ricard.png
sources.author: Arz
sources.notes: Public-domain map used on 1980 French GP pages. Historical full circuit is distinguished by the uninterrupted 1.8 km Mistral Straight.

sources.title: Brands Hatch 1976-1987.svg
sources.author: John Chapman
sources.notes: Diagrammatic map explicitly covering the 1976-1987 Grand Prix configuration and used on the 1980 British GP page.

sources.title: Circuit Hockenheimring-1970.svg
sources.author: Pitlane02
sources.notes: Exact long forest configuration covering the 1980 German Grand Prix.

sources.title: Österreichring 1977-1987.svg
sources.author: Restu20
sources.notes: Exact period family with the Hella-Licht safety change used in 1980.

sources.title: Circuit Zandvoort 1980-1989.png
sources.author: SimLola661
sources.notes: Explicitly 4.226 km and 1980-1989. Alternate Commons map 'Zandvoort layout 1980 1989.png' documents the Marlboro chicane under CC BY 3.0.

sources.title: Imola 1980.jpg
sources.author: Wikimedia uploader / PD-self record
sources.notes: Exact 1980-specific public-domain circuit map. Prefer this over later 1980-1994 diagrams because the Acque Minerali chicane changed after the first F1 events.

sources.title: Montreal 1979.jpg
sources.author: Jiří Žemlička
sources.notes: Public-domain diagram explicitly states the post-1979 changes and use for Canadian GPs from 1979 through 1981.

sources.title: Watkins Glen 1975-1983.png
sources.author: Hmdwgf
sources.notes: Explicitly the 1975-1983 Grand Prix course. RacingCircuits documents the temporary Esses chicane introduced for Formula One in 1975 and removed in 1984.
